title: Delete this video permanently?
goes: Its data, review history, language and YouTube sync state, and preview files are removed from the admin and the database. This cannot be undone.
stays: The audit log and the spend ledger are kept. If it is an episode of a series, the episode stays and can still be redone. The worker's work directory is cleared later under the rules for dropped videos.
youtube: This video is linked to YouTube ({id}). Only the data here is deleted: the video on YouTube and the Drive backup are not touched. To take it down, do so yourself in Studio. After this the admin no longer shows that ID; only the audit log keeps it.
typeSlug: Type the video's slug to confirm:
passwordHelp: Deleting asks for your password again. For five minutes after that, deleting other videos does not.
setPassword: This account has no local password yet. Set one first
